# illumio-cloudsecure_gcp_flow_logs_storage_bucket_source (Resource)

Registers a customer-owned GCP Cloud Storage bucket (by name and optional path prefix) as a source of flow logs for CloudSecure to ingest.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "illumio-cloudsecure_gcp_flow_logs_storage_bucket_source" "flow_log_source" {
  project_id  = "my-gcp-project"
  bucket_name = "my-vpc-flow-logs-bucket"
  path_prefix = "vpc-flow-logs/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the customer-specified GCP Cloud Storage bucket where flow logs are delivered.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the GCP project that owns the Cloud Storage bucket.

### Optional

- `path_prefix` (String) Optional path/prefix within the bucket under which flow log objects are written.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) CloudSecure ID.
